description: TO_NUMBER and its synonyms TO_DECIMAL / TO_NUMERIC: a (precision, scale) pair rounds the value to the requested scale, HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO, while a bare call defaults to NUMBER(38,0) and rounds to a whole number. Decoration in a string input - group separators, a currency symbol - is accepted ONLY when a FORMAT MODEL declares it: live-verified, TO_NUMBER('1,234.56') fails "Numeric value '1,234.56' is not recognized" because the comma is not stripped for free, and a (precision, scale) pair is not a format model either. A format governs PARSING only, so without an explicit (precision, scale) the result still rounds to a whole number. TRY_TO_NUMBER turns the same rejection into NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/ToNumberTest (now retired); the scaled results are stringified so their trailing digits are part of the assertion.
